claude_only.name: Which system of record issues this entry's authoritative identifier, and under what scheme?
How is each posting line addressed, and does that address stay stable across export and re-import?
Which external references - payment end-to-end reference, bank entry reference, source document number - must resolve back to this entry?
Over what scope and for how long is the entry identifier guaranteed unique and never reused?
To which journal, daybook or subledger is the entry assigned, and who governs that code list?
Was the entry keyed manually, generated by an automated interface, or produced from a recurring template?
Which transaction type or bank transaction code describes the economic nature of the posting?
May an entry's classification change after posting, and how would such a change be recorded?
In which ledger or book - statutory, tax, management or parallel framework ledger - is this entry recorded?
Which legal entity and business unit own the ledger, and by which governed identifier are they named?
Which accounting framework and jurisdiction govern the ledger, and what is its functional currency?
When one economic event is posted to several parallel ledgers, how are those postings linked to each other?
What is the minimum and maximum set of posting lines that constitutes a complete entry?
Which account does each line debit or credit, and how is that account reference resolved and validated?
Which attributes belong on the entry header and which must be repeated on every line?
At which level - line set, entry, batch, ledger or currency - must debits equal credits, and to what tolerance?
Which control totals accompany a batch or export, and how are they recomputed on receipt?
What happens to an entry that fails the balancing test at capture, at posting and after export?
Which analytical dimensions - cost centre, project, segment, counterparty, product - may qualify a posting line?
Which dimension values are mandatory for which account ranges, and who sets that rule?
When a line carries a non-monetary quantity or unit, how is it recorded alongside the monetary amount?
Is direction represented by an explicit debit or credit indicator, by a signed amount, or by both, and which representation is authoritative?
In which currency is the line amount denominated, and how is that currency code governed?
What scale and rounding rule apply to the amount, and where is any rounding difference posted?
Are zero-value and negative-value postings permitted, and what do they mean here?
Which additional currency amounts - functional, group reporting or tax - are stored on the line?
Which exchange rate, rate date and rate source were applied, and who published that rate?
How are later revaluation or translation adjustments linked back to the original posting?
Which tax code, tax type and tax jurisdiction apply to the line, and against which taxable base?
How are taxable base, tax amount and any non-deductible portion recorded as separate values?
Which date determines the tax point, and how does it differ from the posting date?
Which distinct date and timestamp roles does this entry carry, and what does each one mean?
How is the accounting event time separated from the system capture or ingestion time on this record?
In what format and offset are instants stored, and how are pure accounting dates distinguished from instants?
Under whose authority may an entry be dated earlier than its capture time, and how is that flagged?
To which fiscal year and accounting period is the entry assigned, and by which rule?
Is the target period open, soft-closed or hard-closed, and who may post into each state?
How are cut-off, accrual and post-closing adjustments identified and separated from routine entries?
What are the permitted states of an entry and the legal transitions between them?
At which state does the entry become immutable, and exactly which fields may no longer change?
How is a pending or provisional posting distinguished from a booked one by downstream consumers?
What becomes of drafts that are never posted, and for how long are they kept?
Is correction made by reversing entry, storno, or negative posting, and which method is authoritative in this ledger?
How are the original entry, the reversing entry and any replacement entry linked in both directions?
Into which period is a reversal posted when the original period is already closed?
Who may authorise a reversal, and what reason code and evidence must accompany it?
What booking status does the underlying transfer carry, and does this posting depend on that status?
At which moment does the transfer become irrevocable and unconditional, and how is that moment evidenced?
How are provisional postings unwound when a transfer is returned, recalled or rejected?
Which source system, interface and batch produced this entry?
Which source document or business event does the entry represent, and how is that reference resolved?
Which posting rule, template or algorithm derived the lines from the source event, and in which version?
Can the entry be re-derived deterministically from its source, and would re-derivation mint a new identifier?
Who entered the entry, under which account, and on whose behalf?
Who approved or released the entry, when, and under which approval rule?
How are entries created by service accounts, robots or scheduled jobs attributed to an accountable human owner?
What does the change record capture for every modification or deletion attempt on a posted record?
How are both the original and the modified version of a record preserved and retrievable?
What control proves that a posted entry has not been altered since posting?
Is the record held in non-rewriteable non-erasable form or under an audit-trail alternative, and who attests to that?
Who is permitted to post to which accounts, periods, amounts and ledgers?
Which combinations of preparation, approval and posting rights are prohibited for a single actor?
Which decision record authorises an automated interface to post without human approval, and how is it revoked?
Which recognition criterion under the applicable framework triggers this posting?
On which measurement basis is the amount determined, and what is the unit of account?
Which event derecognises the asset or liability, and which posting records that removal?
Does the amount rest on an estimate or judgement, and how is that flagged for audit attention?
Which fields are mandatory for an entry to be accepted, and which are conditionally mandatory?
Which referenced objects - account, period, currency, tax code, counterparty - must exist and be active at posting time?
Against which schema version is an incoming entry validated, and what happens to unknown fields?
Does the sum of postings agree to opening and closing account balances for the period?
Are there gaps or duplicates in the entry sequence, and how is each one explained?
How do subledger postings tie out to the general ledger control accounts?
Who attests that the extracted population of entries is complete for the stated scope and period?
Does the entry touch unrelated, unusual or seldom-used account combinations?
Was the entry posted by someone who does not normally post to those accounts?
Was the entry recorded at period end, after close, or outside normal business hours?
Does the entry carry a meaningful description, or is it blank, round-numbered or templated?
Which supporting documents are attached or referenced, and where are they held?
What level of supporting evidence is required for each entry type and amount band?
How is the link between entry and evidence protected against substitution, breakage or loss?
Who may read a posted entry by default, and at what granularity - header, line, amount, narrative?
Which roles may see restricted amounts, counterparties or narratives, and under what conditions?
What obligation exists to furnish entries promptly to auditors, tax authorities or regulators, and through whom?
Which personal data can appear in entry narratives, counterparty fields and attachments?
How is an erasure request reconciled with statutory retention and audit-trail immutability?
For how long must this entry and its evidence be retained, under which rule, and when does the clock start?
Which portion of the retention period requires immediately accessible storage rather than archival storage?
How is a legal hold applied to entries, and what does it suspend?
What record proves lawful disposal at the end of the retention period?
Which exchange profile does the receiving authority or auditor require, and in which version?
Which model fields have no home in the target profile, and how is that loss recorded?
What population, period and entity scope does an export assert, and how is that asserted in the file header?
How are local account numbers mapped to standard or statutory account codes for the profile?
Where do required profiles disagree in semantics, and which one prevails?

grok_only.name: What authoritative master-system identifier did the posting ledger or account servicer assign to this journal entry or booked entry?
Which governed end-to-end or instruction identifiers, if any, correlate this posting to a payment, statement entry or external transaction?
What UUID or ULID did the adopting Dimension assign when no master-system or governed global identifier is reusable as the canonical key?
How are posting-line identifiers formed so they remain unique under reversal, restatement and multi-book copies?
What is the governed type of this journal entry or adjustment, including whether it is standard, adjusting, reversing, recurring, closing, consolidating or a reclassification?
Was the entry initiated manually, generated automatically from a subledger or bank feed, or processed as a top-side adjustment outside the normal course of business?
Which source journal or specialised ledger (general, sales, cash, payroll, tax, memo) originated the entry?
Which reporting entity owns the books in which this entry is recognised, and under which identifier scheme is that entity named?
Which accounting book, ledger view or parallel set of books (statutory, IFRS, local GAAP, tax, management) received the posting?
Who operates the system of record for this posting: the reporting entity, an outsourced accountant, or an account servicer?
In which tax or reporting jurisdiction are these books kept for audit-file and retention purposes?
What header narrative, document number, source journal and preparer attributes describe this journal entry as a whole?
How many posting lines belong to this header, and which line identifiers constitute the complete set?
Which source documents (invoice, bank statement, contract, spreadsheet) are referenced from the header as the economic origin of the entry?
Is the header a complete balanced set, a proposed or parked set, or an incomplete import batch that must not yet post?
Which financial account and optional sub-account dimensions receive this posting line?
Is the line a debit or a credit, and is that fact stored as a code rather than a signed amount?
What line narrative and cost objects, divisions or other analytical dimensions accompany the account posting?
If the line originated from bank reporting, what bank transaction code domain, family and sub-family classify the cash movement?
Do the header's debit totals equal its credit totals in the balancing currency, and what is the residual if they do not?
Is this object a single-sided bank-booked entry still awaiting counterpart posting, or a complete journal that already balances?
What exception, intercompany lag or currency rounding rule is allowed to leave a residual, and who must clear it?
What unsigned amount and ISO 4217 currency, including minor-unit exponent, apply to each posting line?
If the line currency differs from the functional or balancing currency, what rate, rate type, rate source and conversion time were used?
Which currencies play the transaction, functional and presentation roles for this entry?
Is this posting an original transaction, a foreign-currency revaluation, or a translation adjustment?
Which financial-statement elements does this entry recognise or derecognise, and is recognition justified by the applicable framework?
On which measurement basis are the posted amounts stated, and does that basis differ from the cash amount booked by the account servicer?
Which accounting policy or materiality judgement authorised this recognition when no specific standard line-item rule applies?
What is the current lifecycle state of the journal entry, and which timestamps mark each completed transition?
Which role is allowed to move this entry from its current state to each permitted next state?
If the entry is posted, is in-place update forbidden so that any correction must create a reversing or restating entry?
Is this entry a reversal, a correcting entry, a prior-period restatement, or an auto-reversing accrual, and which original entry does it supersede?
Is this adjustment a consolidating, combination, reclassification or other top-side item that is not reflected as a formal journal entry in the general ledger?
Was the entry recorded at period end or post-close, to seldom-used accounts, by an unusual preparer, or with round-number or unexplained characteristics?
Who initiated this entry and who authorized it, and are those persons different under the segregation-of-duties rule?
Through which IT systems or interfaces was the entry recorded and processed, including subledger feeds?
Which roles may read the entry or its supporting evidence, and which fields are restricted as personal or commercially sensitive?
Was any control overridden, and what management or system override evidence exists?
Is the target fiscal period open for this book, and if closed what exception grant allows this posting?
What is the default access rule for creating or changing entries in this book, and which scoped exceptions apply?
Do any lines carry personal data (for example payroll names) that require a stricter access scope than the header?
What are the document, posting, value and booking date-times of this event, each with seconds and an explicit offset or Z?
When was this record observed or ingested by the Dimension, and does that time differ from the accounting event time?
When was the entry captured (entered) versus when was it posted to the ledger, and who performed each act?
To which fiscal period and reporting year is this posting assigned, and which calendar produces that period?
Does the economic event belong in this period under the entity's cutoff policy, or should it be accrued or reversed into another period?
Are the financial statements that will consume this posting prepared on a going-concern basis for the specified period?
From which source system, message or extract did this posting originate, and what identifiers chain it back to that source?
What integrity hash, electronic signature or control total attests that the posted record is unaltered?
Which mappings or transformations were applied between the source message and the posted journal, and who owns those mappings?
What supporting documents corroborate this entry, and do they corroborate or contradict the posting?
Is the evidence sufficiently precise and complete for audit or tax-file use, including account numbers and explanations?
Who holds the original evidence, and is it immutable for the retention period?
Was the journal-entry population tested for accuracy and completeness, including entries imported into analysis tools?
Which fraud-risk criteria selected this entry for testing, and what rationale exists if a matching entry was excluded?
What did individuals involved in processing journal entries say about inappropriate or unusual activity, and is that inquiry documented?
What retention period and legal basis apply to this posted entry and its evidence in the relevant jurisdiction?
Is the entry under legal hold, tax audit or other freeze that forbids deletion or alteration?
If the entry is unposted draft, may it be discarded, and if posted, is only a reversing entry allowed rather than physical delete?
How is this journal projected to XBRL GL accountingEntries, entryHeader and entryDetail, including which modules (COR, BUS, MUC, USK, TAF, SRCD) are required?
How does a bank-to-customer statement entry map to a posting, including servicer reference, credit-debit indicator, booking and value times, and bank transaction code?
Which semantic conflicts (single-sided cash entry versus balanced journal, market transaction versus posting, recognition date versus booking date) are recorded for this instance?
Must this population be exported through XBRL GL TAF or a national tax-audit file, and which profile applies?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
